name: Shelf zooplankton
description: The tiny drifting grazers of the open shelf - meso- and macrozooplankton. Functional group pooling the source's mesozooplankton and macrozooplankton compartments (two size classes measured separately), the most-eaten prey of the whole web: sardine, anchovy, sardinellas, mackerel and young fish all filter them from the upwelling-enriched water.
